messages:
maria-ramirez: Quick heads-up — PR #2173 (optimize-batching) is green on linux but mac E2E is failing intermittently. Looks like a timezone-related test flake in `tests/e2e/timezone_spec.py`. We need to land before the 18:00 PT deploy freeze. Any chance to get a short rebase window or prioritize CI?

akshay-gupta: I can take the rebase, but CI queue is backed up (~40m). If we rebase now it'll likely sit. Is this blocking the release or can we delay until next slot?

maria-ramirez: Ideally land before freeze — the change reduces tail latency on embeddings by ~8%, so it's worth the risk. If queue is too long, can we request a priority run?

jen-obrien: @akshay-gupta can you attach the failing log line? Maybe it's a flaky assert we can patch quickly instead of rebasing.

akshay-gupta: Pasted the failing snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: expected tzoffset == 0 but got -1
E   File "/srv/app/tests/e2e/timezone_spec.py", line 42, in test_utc_conversion
```
It only fails on mac-locales in CI. Seems unrelated to my change, but it blocks the suite.

timothy-lee: If it's unrelated flake, we can rerun just the mac E2E job. I can trigger a rerun now and watch it. If it passes, we can merge without rebase.

maria-ramirez: That works. Can you trigger and ping here? I won't rebase while a rerun is in-flight.

deploy-bot: mac-e2e (job 8792) retriggered by timothy-lee — queued (est ~18m).

timothy-lee: Rerun started. Watching logs.

timothy-lee: Looks like the job hit the same flaky assert early; I'm going to re-run again, sometimes it needs two attempts.

deploy-bot: mac-e2e (job 8792) rerun #2 started — queued (est ~12m).

jen-obrien: If reruns fail twice, I can add a small guard to the test to make it tolerant (wrap assert in tolerance or mock TZ). That would be a 2-line change and fast review.

maria-ramirez: Prefer the guard if it's low-risk. Can you put up a tiny PR and tag reviewers? We should avoid rebase + long CI wait before freeze.

jen-obrien: I'll open PR now and ping approvers. Expect ~10m for CI.

akshay-gupta: Thanks — that sounds safer. If jen's PR lands, I'll rebase and try to land #2173 quickly.

deploy-bot: mac-e2e (job 8792) rerun #2 finished — status: failed.

timothy-lee: Confirmed failure. Jen, go ahead with the guard PR. If you need a fast review I can prioritize.

jen-obrien: PR 2176 opened: `test: tolerate mac timezone flake` — small patch, CC @timothy-lee @maria-ramirez.

jen-obrien: CI green on PR 2176 (mac-e2e passed).

maria-ramirez: Nice. akshay, looks like you can rebase now. We have ~30m before freeze. Please ping when you push.

akshay-gupta: Rebase done and pushed. CI triggered for #2173. Small heads-up: I changed the changelog entry to include perf numbers.

deploy-bot: CI for PR 2173 started — jobs: linux-unit, mac-e2e, integration. Estimated completion ~22m.

timothy-lee: I'll keep an eye on CI. If anything flakes again we can fast-fail and discuss emergency exemption with release lead.

akshay-gupta: CI green across the board — all checks passed. Ready to merge when someone with merge rights gives the final :eyes:.

maria-ramirez: Giving :thumbsup: — merging now to beat the freeze.

deploy-bot: PR 2173 merged by maria-ramirez. Canary deploy queued.

maria-ramirez: Thanks team! Shipping this before freeze avoided having to slip the release.

timothy-lee: Great work coordinating. Jen — nice quick fix. akshay — nice rebase hustle.

jen-obrien: Glad it helped. I'll follow up with a tiny note in the test doc about mac ci quirks. :smile:
